capabilities: Share vault documents to a team drive with collaborative editing
Co-edit documents in real time via Yjs over WebSocket
Sync installed plugins and settings across team members
Generate daily and monthly team reports
Summarize documents using OpenAI or Claude
extras: Manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice. The README documents network usage, telemetry (none collected), and privacy behavior at length, and warns that review of the backend's data retention policies is the user's responsibility.
problem: Obsidian is a single-user, local-first app with no built-in way for a team to share and co-edit vault documents or keep plugins aligned across members.

relations.evidence: Real-time co-editing: Multi-user editing powered by Yjs
AI summaries: Summarize documents using OpenAI or Claude
